posts.title: Cold front brings a cooler week to Brownsville
posts.excerpt: The National Weather Service in Brownsville says northerly winds will hold Brownsville highs in the 60s through Thanksgiving. Wednesday and Thursday morning lows drop into the 40s.
posts.body:
[The National Weather Service in Brownsville](https://forecast.weather.gov/product.php?site=DMX&issuedby=BRO&product=AFD&format=CI&version=4&glossary=0) says northerly winds will hold Brownsville highs in the 60s through Thanksgiving.
Wednesday and Thursday morning lows drop into the 40s.

posts.title: Genie 4 now available through the Gemini API
posts.excerpt: Genie 4 generates continuous 720p worlds with synchronized native audio from a text prompt, a reference image, or both. Real-time keyboard controls and live text prompts let you navigate and change…
posts.body: [Genie 4](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/genie-4-in-gemini-api/) generates continuous 720p worlds with synchronized native audio from a text prompt, a reference image, or both. Real-time keyboard controls and live text prompts let you navigate and change weather, lighting, objects, or events on the fly.

posts.title: PS5SD 1.8.5 released for jailbroken PS5
posts.excerpt: PS5SD 1.8.5 pauses downloads together when Civitai rate-limits them, retrying on a backoff instead of giving up after about a minute. It also adds a search box to the prompt collections, so you can…
posts.body: [PS5SD 1.8.5](https://store.brewology.com/ps5/ps5sd/) pauses downloads together when Civitai rate-limits them, retrying on a backoff instead of giving up after about a minute. It also adds a search box to the prompt collections, so you can find a collection by name or by its entries.

posts.title: XPS5 1.1.0 lands for jailbroken PS5
posts.excerpt: XPS5 1.1.0 adds encrypted X Chat to the jailbroken-PS5 X app. If you are still on 1.0.1, install it by hand, since the 99.9 MiB installer exceeds that version’s update limit.
posts.body: [XPS5 1.1.0](https://store.brewology.com/ps5/xps5/) adds encrypted X Chat to the jailbroken-PS5 X app. If you are still on 1.0.1, install it by hand, since the 99.9 MiB installer exceeds that version’s update limit.

posts.title: Deportation appeals cut to 10 days from December 17
posts.excerpt: The Justice Department's final rule cuts most deportation appeals to 10 calendar days for decisions issued on or after December 17, 2026. A single Board member must dismiss an appeal within 15 days…
posts.body: [The Justice Department's final rule](https://mikebakerlaw.com/blog/2026/11/21/bia-appeal-rule-ten-day-deadline-final/) cuts most deportation appeals to 10 calendar days for decisions issued on or after December 17, 2026. A single Board member must dismiss an appeal within 15 days unless a majority votes to hear it.

posts.body: [New NVIDIA RTX Spark compact desktops](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/rtx-spark-desktop-local-ai-available-now/?type=News) from ASUS, Dell and MSI are available now, bringing local AI agents, image and video generation, and model fine-tuning to a dedicated Windows PC. posts.title: ORR proposes monitoring overhaul for care facilities
posts.excerpt: ORR published a November 18 proposal overhauling monitoring and compliance for its care provider facilities, with comments due December 18, 2026. It would create an Advisory Terminations List for…
posts.body: [ORR published a November 18 proposal](https://thefederalregister.org/documents/2026-23460/submission-for-office-of-management-and-budget-review-monitoring-and-compliance-for-office-of-refugee-resettlement-care-) overhauling monitoring and compliance for its care provider facilities, with comments due December 18, 2026. It would create an Advisory Terminations List for staff dismissed over substantiated child-safety allegations, so they cannot move unchecked to another shelter.
